articles.title: Veteran actor Irma P Hall, star of The Ladykillers, dies aged 91
articles.summary: Once a Dallas school teacher, Hall became a star in later life with roles in Soul Food and Collateral

articles.title: Tyler Perry’s The Gospel of Christmas review – Netflix unloads more slapdash festive fare
articles.summary: Incompetent direction almost kills the Christmas spirit but American Idol winner Fantasia Barrino Taylor brings down the house

articles.title: How to Rob a Bank review – Amazon’s anti-capitalist caper is far from a riot
articles.summary: Nicholas Hoult, Anna Sawai and Pete Davidson play Robin Hood in this simple-minded and unexciting attempt to mix social commentary with action

articles.title: Prima Facie review – Cynthia Erivo’s brilliant barrister blazes in sexual assault drama
articles.summary: Adaptation of the international stage hit stars a commanding Erivo as Tessa, whose career defending rape suspects is undermined by experience

articles.title: Give Me the Ball! review – tennis trailblazer Billie Jean King is ferocious force for equality
articles.summary: Sparky and engaging documentary about the ‘battle of the sexes’ player, who fought her whole career to ensure the women’s game got the respect it deserved

articles.title: Female Perversions review – Tilda Swinton searches for erotic adventures in rework of Madame Bovary
articles.summary: The actor’s 1996 first US film, as a lawyer trying to manage her complicated love life and traumatic fantasies, marked her out as a screen presence like no other

articles.title: NAZA documentary on Gaza killings becomes one of year’s most watched
articles.summary: The film, which details Israel’s surveillance of Palestinian civilians, has been seen by more than 1.5m people in less than two months

articles.title: Tinto Brass obituary
articles.summary: Italian director drawn to the erotic best known for his 1979 film Caligula, which is now regarded as a cult favourite
